meta.comment: Chioni — navigation manifest of the PHARMACIE space only (the 5th space, S9/ADR 0022 décision 10). THIRD manifest of the repo, and separate for the same reason as the platform one (S4): nav-manifest.json declares itself CENTRE-ONLY in its own meta and feeds three surfaces that all live inside the centre shell (sidebar, breadcrumb, ⌘K palette). An officine is not a tenant — its four entries have no business in a director's command palette, and the reverse would be worse. Same node contract as Vireo ({id,title,slug,icon,parent,section,order,badge,keywords,inMenu,alias}) and the same indexing code (indexManifest): one contract, three data files. Slugs include the 'pharmacie/' prefix so hrefForSlug maps 1:1 to routes. NO role gating exists here and none is expected: an officine has no hierarchy (ADR 0022 §12) — every active member does the same work.
